findings.claim: ∃ r: r.auth.uid == uid ∧ source(r) == dashboard ∧ allow(r, write)
findings.fix: Use custom claims or App Check to enforce read-only access for the dashboard.
findings.title: Firestore rules allow writes from read-only dashboard

findings.claim: ∃ push: fails after batch 1 ⇒ headSeq not updated ∧ retry fails on !exists()
findings.fix: Update metaRef in every batch or remove the !exists check to allow idempotent retries.
findings.title: Partial push failure permanently breaks sync due to create-only rules

findings.claim: ∃ cmd ∈ {rebase, submodule, fetch, clone}: guard(cmd)=allow ∧ effect(cmd) ∈ Destructive
findings.fix: Add explicit block rules for git rebase, submodule, fetch, and clone -c.
findings.title: Guard allows arbitrary code execution via git subcommands

findings.claim: runTool(cmd) passes process.env verbatim when opts.env is omitted
findings.fix: Filter sensitive variables (like GEMINI_API_KEY) from process.env before spawning child processes.
findings.title: Tool runner leaks parent environment secrets to child processes

findings.fix: Reject commas in PowerShell cmdlet targets as they are treated as arrays by the shell.
findings.title: Guard bypass via PowerShell array comma separator

findings.claim: ∃ L, L': L ≠ L' ∧ parse(L) == parse(L') ∧ verify(L) == ok ∧ verify(L') == ok
findings.fix: Compute the hash over the exact byte payload of the event JSON string rather than re-stringifying it.
findings.title: Hash chain verification ignores whitespace and JSON key order changes

findings.claim: getEvents(from, head) fetches all missing events in a single query
findings.fix: Paginate the fetching of events in syncPull.
findings.title: Missing pagination in syncPull causes OOM on large projects

findings.claim: ∃ interleaved executions where N concurrent calls increase the counter by < N
findings.fix: Use atomic updates or a file lock when incrementing AI usage.
findings.invariant: new: Quota enforcement must be sound
findings.title: AI quota bypass via race condition in usage increment

findings.claim: maskSecrets(text) fails to match camelCase keys or values with spaces
findings.fix: Update the CREDENTIAL regex to support camelCase patterns and values containing spaces.
findings.title: Credential redaction regex bypasses for camelCase and spaces

findings.claim: package.json includes full firebase web SDK instead of lightweight clients
findings.fix: Migrate from the web firebase SDK to firebase-admin or standard fetch for reduced size.
findings.invariant: new: CLI footprint should be minimal
findings.title: Bloated CLI due to heavy firebase web SDK dependency
